items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: What's your best hope in where you can finish in qualifying? "I don't know yet. I think the…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：Q：您在排位赛中的最佳期望是什么？“我还不知道。我觉得两场排位赛中的Ferrari赛车都表现非常迅速。尤其是Lando，他的表现相当有竞争力。嗯，梅赛德赛车的情况也很难预测。让我们拭目以待，但如果我们能够度过一个出色的比赛日，那么很有可能获得更好的成绩。”
items.summary: Q: What's your best hope in where you can finish in qualifying? "I don't know yet. I think the Ferraris have looked very quick in both sessions. Lando looked competitive in that one especially. Yeah I think the Mercedes is very hard to read. Let's wait and see tomorrow but I think if we execute a good day then it seems there can be a lot up for grabs."
items.summary_zh: Q：您在排位赛中的最佳期望是什么？“我还不知道。我觉得两场排位赛中的Ferrari赛车都表现非常迅速。尤其是Lando，他的表现相当有竞争力。嗯，梅赛德赛车的情况也很难预测。让我们拭目以待，但如果我们能够度过一个出色的比赛日，那么很有可能获得更好的成绩。”

items.title: X repost from @laurogeitabat: Q: How on top of the new parts did you get with only one session? "I didn't have them today. I…
items.title_zh: X 转帖 @laurogeitabat：Q：在只进行了一次试驾的情况下，新的部件究竟带来了怎样的效果呢？“今天我没有使用它们。我觉得在 Lando 的车上，这些部件的表现如预期般良好，这很不错。虽然这些部件并没有完全改变车辆的性能，显然我们并没有预料到这种情况，不过，如果能有这样的表现就好了。明天我会再试驾一下我的车，希望今天能有一个成功的试驾体验！”
items.summary: Q: How on top of the new parts did you get with only one session? "I didn't have them today. I think on Landos car, they've been working as expected which is good. I don't think they've completely changed the car which obviously we weren't expecting but, would've been nice. We'll see what it's like on my car tomorrow and hopefully we can have a successful day!"
items.summary_zh: Q：在只进行了一次试驾的情况下，新的部件究竟带来了怎样的效果呢？“今天我没有使用它们。我觉得在 Lando 的车上，这些部件的表现如预期般良好，这很不错。虽然这些部件并没有完全改变车辆的性能，显然我们并没有预料到这种情况，不过，如果能有这样的表现就好了。明天我会再试驾一下我的车，希望今天能有一个成功的试驾体验！”

items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: How did you assess FP2? "Very very challenging for sure. I think the track conditions are pr…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：Q：您对 二练 赛道的评价如何？ “确实非常具有挑战性。我觉得赛道条件相当苛刻。风很大，赛道上的新部分也不太适合高速行驶。而且赛道表面磨损严重，整体来说就是个非常具有挑战性的赛道。显然，因为无法参加练习赛，所以比赛难度更大了。”
items.summary: Q: How did you assess FP2? "Very very challenging for sure. I think the track conditions are pretty challenging out there. Very windy, the new parts of the track are...not very grippy. And kind of, not breaking apart but they're very wore so just a very challenging circuit at the moment. Obviously missing a practice sessions made it pretty tough."

items.title: X repost from @oscarsspiastree: 🚨 Oscar Piastri on if he feels he's the passenger of an AI program when it comes to the PUs "So…
items.title_zh: X 转帖 @oscarsspiastree：🚨 Oscar Piastri谈到 PUs 时表示：“有时候，确实如此……驾驶一辆在直线赛道结束前就损失了一半动力的赛车，这种感觉确实很难理解。甚至在斯帕赛道上，我们很多比赛都是只使用内燃机，没有电池辅助，这种感觉本身就很奇怪。有些弯道能获得一定的动力，而有些则完全没有动力。我觉得斯帕赛道特别令人沮丧，不仅对我如此，对很多人来说也是如此，因为代码中的一些小差异以及发动机的工作方式，会极大地影响单圈时间。尤其是在赛道的靠前位置，当时只有 9 百分之一左右的差距就能决定 4 名车手的排名，而有些车手拥有的动力优势则远远超过 9 百分之一，但他们却无法控制这种差异。”
items.summary: 🚨 Oscar Piastri on if he feels he's the passenger of an AI program when it comes to the PUs "Sometimes, yes. ...The principle of driving a race car that loses effectively half of its power before the end of the straight is hard to get your head around sometimes." "Even in Spa, a lot of the middle sector we were doing it just on the combustion engine, with no battery assistance at all, which is a weird feeling in itself, having some corners with a certain amount of power & others with full power. I think Spa was particularly frustrating, not just for me but for quite a lot of others, because those small differences in the code & what the engines did made quite a big difference in lap time. Especially at the front of the field, I think there were still only 9 hundredths or something separating 4 positions & there were definitely more than 9 hundredths on the table for quite a few drivers with nothing they could control."
